title: VertiRTA: Bare-Metal Fault-Tolerant Run-Time Assurance, Verified Bilingual Contingency Co-Pilot, and License-Clean Active Visual SLZ Perception for Urban Coaxial eVTOLs
description: Open-source, 100% Apache-2.0 research and software-verification testbed for the VertiRTA-X8-240 240 kg coaxial X8 urban eVTOL in Istanbul (Maltepe-Dragos-Kartal coastal corridor bounded by LTFJ/LTBX CTRs). Integrates a zero-heap bare-metal C++17 flight core (28,886 B Cortex-M7 Flash, 0 B static RAM, 2,960 B stack DAG), 100 Hz HJI-CBVF-QP safety filter with isolated CSFL/CEL survival envelope atlas (30,000 6-DOF simulations), asynchronous TR/EN neuro-symbolic contingency co-pilot (GBNF + Z3 QF_LRA + zero-heap STL monitor + Split Conformal gating), and foundation-distilled active visual Safe Landing Zone perception. Research testbed only; zero airworthiness certification claim.
notes: Research, simulation, and software-verification testbed only. Does NOT claim DO-178C, DO-254, EASA SC-VTOL, SORA 2.5, or SHGM SHT-IHA airworthiness certification or operational compliance.
